system.description:
You seek to emulate the power of one of the Seven Deadly Sins of Humanity in your blade, imbuing the Sin of Sloth inside the edge. Make a melee taijutsu Attack against a creature in range. On a hit you deal your weapons damage+3d6.

Chain 1: On a hit, the target creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, their initiative count is reduced by 2 as they lose the motivation to act as fast as before.

At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
